answer: A concrete sybil filter is voyage-bonded admission: before an agent may act, it escrows an opal-priced stake, and every identity becomes one thread in a correlation graph. When wallets vote or attest in lockstep, the whole thread's bonds are slashed in proportion to collusion evidence. Attackers must capitalise each fake identity up front, and clustering risks burning every escrow at once, so mass campaigns turn capital-negative while honest solo agents simply post a bond once.
